name: NEW RIVER VALLEY COMMUNITY SERVICES
ai_summary: Draft rating: medium. The latest audit (2024) has two minor findings on Department of Behavioral Health and Developmental Services (DBHDS) money, both about late filing, which is low on the flags alone. I moved it up one level because the auditor traces both to vacant finance posts, the same audit disclosed a material weakness (a serious control gap) in the financial statements, and it was accepted 15 months after year end.

name: COUNTY OF FLOYD
ai_summary: Floyd County's 2025 audit has three findings on federal awards, two of them serious, all touching Coronavirus State and Local Fiscal Recovery Funds passed through the Department of Criminal Justice Services and the Department of Housing and Community Development. None is a repeat or flagged with questioned costs, and 2023 and 2024 show no federal award findings, so the rating is medium. I did not move it up, but the reviewer should weigh two things: the missing procurement manual spans several programs, and the 2025 and 2024 audits were filed late (14 and 13 months after year end).

name: SHENANDOAH AREA AGENCY ON AGING, INC
ai_summary: Medium risk. The latest audit (2024) has one finding on Department for Aging and Rehabilitative Services (DARS) money, and it repeats the 2023 finding: the year-end report to DARS did not match the agency's own books. It is not a material weakness, has no questioned costs, and I made no adjustment from the text. No 2025 audit is in the evidence.

name: WYTHEVILLE REDEVELOPMENT & HOUSING AUTHORITY
ai_summary: The 2025 audit has one finding, which the auditor marked as a material weakness (the most serious kind of control failure): about 44% of tested housing voucher files lacked required signatures. It is not a repeat, has no questioned costs, and the 2023 and 2024 audits have no findings, so the rubric gives medium. The finding is on HUD voucher money with no Virginia state agency recognised as passing it down, and the 2025 and 2023 audits were filed late.

name: Middle Peninsula Planning District Commission
